title: 四季织锦

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1024×1536 vertical tarot card master artwork for a local World holographic-card project.
Input image: the immediately previous displayed World tarot card is a reference for symbolic identity and full-body dancer composition, not a crop.
Primary request: create the World tarot theme “四季织锦 / Four Seasons Brocade”: exactly one full-body adult woman dancer in a wine-violet dress, centered and slightly side-facing inside exactly one front-facing vertical oval ring of woven textiles and gold leaves. Her pointed foot visibly touches one complete shallow water platform. The four fixed guardian figures remain in safe inner corners: exactly one lion upper-left, one bull upper-right, one winged human lower-left, one eagle lower-right. Behind them, four muted seasonal landscape windows unite into one complete garden: spring blossom, summer green, autumn amber leaves, winter pale snow; the guardians must not move with the seasonal windows.
Style/medium: richly detailed painterly fantasy tarot, woven brocade textures and pressed gold, Art Nouveau border, no readable title text.
Composition/framing: 2:3 vertical; full body, vertical ring front-on, clear corner guardians behind the garden windows; no cropping.
Lighting/mood: warm integrated seasonal twilight, wine purple, low-saturation seasonal colors, gold accents.
Constraints: exactly one dancer and one oval ring; exact guardian positions; one intact foot-contact water platform; no rotation effect, no duplicate animals/people/rings, no text, watermark or cropped anatomy.
